what: Two brush strokes of thickness 3000 cover the screen. The ribbon stroke thickens (1s power2.in), slides along the line from 7% to a 40~47% share drawing one stroke of the logo in 1.1s power2.out, then exits and thins. The logo rises to the center in .8s, and the letters pop out from 0 scale tilted ±25° at .1s intervals over .6s back.out(3) (the whole thing at 1.25x speed, .25s late). Once the page has fully loaded and 2 seconds pass, after a .2s rest the top stroke shrinks to half its length with thickness 1000 and exits to the bottom right (900, 1800) in .65s power2.inOut. 25% later the bottom stroke exits to the bottom left over the same length, so the screen opens. The logo disappears in .15s at 20% of the top stroke. When done, fx:done fires.

options.[data-fx-part=sweep]: Two thick brush-stroke paths covering the screen (the first is the lower panel) — svg preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"
options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Logo group (g or svg) — rises to the center last and vanishes as the cover lifts
options.[data-fx-part=ribbon]: Ribbon path that draws the logo and passes by (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=draw]: Single-stroke logo path drawn as the ribbon passes (optional)
options.skip: If nav, a page reached by clicking a same-site link opens straight away with no curtain (a refresh plays it)
options.min: Minimum seconds to keep waiting even after everything is received, default 2 — 0 if switched often like an app
options.sweep: Seconds for one brush stroke to drop out, default .65
options.cover · thin: Brush stroke thickness when covering · when exiting (svg units), default 3000 · 1000
options.drift: Distance pushed while exiting x, y (svg units), default 900, 1800 — the second brush stroke has x reversed
options.lift: Distance the logo rises (share of logo height), default .06

from.where: shared.js·every page .tw-loader — original initTwo26PageLoader (pink·orange brush stroke thickness 3000→1000, ribbon W drawing, T·O·2·6 back.out(3), 2s minimum, internal navigation skips it via sessionStorage)

note: In the original, the walk starts at 2 seconds even if the logo drawing isn’t finished (the whole logo drawing is about 4 seconds). While walking, the logo drawing doesn’t stop and fades along. Brush color is the caller’s css (stroke)
